description: Withdrawn ISO 4217 codes and non-ISO codes for @ducatjs/money/historic. Codes, names and withdrawal dates come from ISO 4217 List Three (data/iso4217-list-three.xml). List Three has no minor units, so each exponent here is the one ISO 4217 gave the code while it was current. Only codes whose exponent is sourced are included.

exponents.note: OpenJDK's currency data (dataVersion 180) keeps the ISO 4217 minor units of withdrawn codes; codes it lists as minorUndefined (XFO, XFU) are not monetary and are left out

CNH.name: Chinese Yuan Renminbi (offshore)
CNH.note: the offshore renminbi traded in Hong Kong; not an ISO 4217 code, listed by Adyen
